year_level.note: Across years: share of series the model fails vs share with a bad yield.

description: Backtest of the Field Shift replay against Tamil Nadu district yields (DES Crop Statistics, 2001-02 to 2022-23). Bad year = bottom 25% of Theil-Sen-detrended yield anomaly per district x crop. Model fail = the engine's replay says the crop failed that season (water, heat or flood) at the district HQ's nearest grid point; rice replayed as tank-irrigated, other crops rain-fed.
